## Device Information
- **Device Model:** [e.g. iPhone 14 Pro, Samsung Galaxy S23]
- **OS Version:** [e.g. iOS 17.4, Android 14]
- **Unity Version:** [e.g. 6000.1.0f1]
- **App Version:** [e.g. 0.1.0-alpha]

## Bug Description
A clear and concise description of the bug.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Open the app
2. Point camera at...
3. Tap on...
4. See error / unexpected behavior

## Expected vs Actual Behavior
- **Expected:** [What should have happened]
- **Actual:** [What actually happened]

## AR Context
- **Lighting conditions:** [Bright / Dim / Mixed / Outdoor]
- **Surface type:** [Painted wall / Wood door / Glass / Textured]
- **Plane detection working?** [Yes / No / Partial]
- **Tracking state at time of bug:** [Tracking / Limited / Lost]
- **Occlusion mode:** [Ultra / High / Medium / Low / Off]

## Performance Context
- **Was the device hot?** [Yes / No]
- **Approximate FPS (from debug panel):** [e.g. 55]
- **Memory usage (from debug panel):** [e.g. 280 MB]

## Severity
- [ ] **Critical** - App crashes, data loss, or complete feature failure
- [ ] **High** - Major feature broken, no workaround
- [ ] **Medium** - Feature partially broken, workaround exists
- [ ] **Low** - Minor visual/UX issue

## Attachments
Please attach any of the following:
- Screenshots
- Screen recordings
- Unity log files (`Player.log`)
- Performance report (`PerfReport.txt`)
